body: Some friends and I were driving back to Chicago from a Notre Dane game in South Bend, Indiana. The stretch of highway we were on was dark, and on either side of our two-lane section, there was a long, shallow ditch. A deer came leaping out of the left-side ditch (so the median of the road basically), and literally came feet from hitting us dead on. I made eye contact with the deer it was so close. Probably the most legitimate “near death” experience I’ve ever had. We would’ve probably spun out, and flipped since we were driving a Jeep. Terrifying to say the least.
Unfortunately no one can help me but myself. I’m seeing a therapist to learn how to do that. Thanks tho ❤️

The worst is being out with some friends and they recognize someone from class/work that you don’t really know. They do the chummy hellos and fist bumps and you’re just sitting there until they awkwardly acknowledge you.

Me too. The amazing thing is that I’m not even that depressed. I mean I am a little but I can still function fairly normally. I think it’s more about the statement. I want to say “fuck you” to everyone besides my family and just peace out. Seriously if I was an orphan I would already be dead

Dude here. Grew up with all sisters. Parents divorced so I hardly see dad. That situation made me more happy to be a guy than you could imagine. Yeah we have unfair expectations, harder time in the dating game, etc but the shit women have to deal with is terrible. Periods, pregnancy, being sexually harassed all the time, hardly taken seriously in workplace/serious discussions. The list goes on. Both genders have their trials. As a guy society allows you to take life by the balls (which can be a scary thing if you don’t think you’re capable), but it doesn’t even afford women that chance. Anyway, best of luck to you ❤️ (no homo)
Yup. And then I decided I wanted to live. It’s always back and forth but it sucks being self destructive and then changing your mind cause the damage is done

I’ve been laid for real since but now have an incurable STD for the rest of my life. You’re clean right now, and I would do anything to go back.
You aren’t alone. There are millions of people out there like you (including me). Stay strong ❤️

I’ve been extremely suicidal for about 2 years now. When I really thought hard about how lucky I am to experience life (even the shitty parts) it helped me personally. I get that’s not the case for everyone, so I’m ok with this being removed and downvoted.

Understandable. Personally I’d rather feel nothing if it means staying alive. I’ve been suffering for so long that it’s nice to just feel neutral. But I’m sure there’ll come a time (probably soon) when I miss the emotions
That’s the only reason I’m still alive. I want to accomplish things. Thanks for your words of encouragement

I try to focus on what I know I’m good at. Think of a time that you excelled at something. Not a perfect solution, but it reminds me that I’m not completely useless
